posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Shackomatic said:
The last image is when I try to run a battle without putting the enemy in the sv_enemies folder. It used to work in an older project but I'm neck deep in it and I don't really know why it's doing that.
Click to expand...
Because you have an image selected in the database entry for your enemy, which can only be selected from the sv_enemies folder.
You can get rid of that if you're specifying an image via notetags.
Your original error is saying you're calling a motion that's not defined. It looks like you don't have the notetags to define the YED motions in your enemy's notes.
As a side note, you should not have any filenames in your project with spaces in them. Notice how everything included with RPG Maker MV uses camelCase and underscores - there are no spaces.
Using URL-incompatible characters, such as spaces, can cause your files to produce loading errors for people trying to play your deployed game.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Okay...I understand, but I'd suggest you're confusing people (or at least me) with your non-standard terminology.
Instead of talking about "smooth frames," "smooth animations" (which is the wrong word entirely, you're talking about motions) and "fluid sprites," just say "Sideview Battler spritesheets." Or "YED sprites." Or something like that, using established terminology so we know what you're talking about.
When you talk about your enemy not having smooth frames, it sounds like it's using the spritesheet you made but something is glitching graphically.
As far as your issues - I could not reproduce your issue with it only taking 3 frames from your spritesheet. I suspect you might have an incorrectly formatted sheet with the same filename in one of your folders.
I
did
have an issue with the sprites flashing from left to right across the screen. I Googled "rpg maker yami sideview enemy" to see what problems other people have had, and this post fixed the problem:
Issue with Yanflys Animated Sideview enemies
So this plugin use to work as it was supposed to,    	but ever since the rpg maker mv update ive had an issue where the sprites "dance"   	like so:   	https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N4u0nxYDn2A   	Any idea how to fix this or if something else could be causing this?
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Using the spritesheet you provided, the notetags you wrote, and adding
<Sideview Width: 672>
it appears to work as expected in my test game.
